text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page: SEV2 - customer "Vermillion" (vpc-verm-02) seeing sustained 502/503s from dedicated pool leader. Alert at 08:12 UTC.
raj: I'm taking the page, joining bridge now.
sophie: I can open emergency bridge and start traffic snapshots. link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/4959876543
yuri: preliminary logs show repeated kernel OOMs during model init on node gpu-21; will check current artifact version.
paul: tagging infra: possible noisy neighbor? the host shows high CUDA mem pressure.
jen: Vermillion ops, we're contacting your oncall to discuss failover. please standby.
raj: running `kubectl get pods -n vermillion -o wide` -> several pods in CrashLoopBackOff on leader nodes.
ops-bot: Auto-action: snapshot-pool --pool=verm-01 -> s3://redwood-alerts/4959876543/snapshots at 08:16 UTC
sophie: can we cordon host gpu-21 and move traffic? we have standby pool verm-standby-a ready.
paul: propose soft-tenant-isolate: `tenant-isolate --tenant=vermillion --mode=soft --drain=graceful` to reduce blast radius. anyone object?
yuri: go ahead. I'll watch for cold-start surge.
raj: isolation executed at 08:18 UTC. New connections routed to standby. Still seeing intermittent 502s from warmup sub-requests.
jen: Vermillion oncall (ops@verm.co) approved failover at 08:19 UTC, requests official credit calc.
yuri: root cause hypothesis: model artifact v5.0.0-quant contains incompatible kernel selection leading to sporadic OOMs when sequence length > 2048; combined with aggressive auto-scaling caused many cold starts.
sophie: rolling back standby to v5.0.0 (non-quant) now, will prewarm with smoke tests.
ops-bot: Rollout paused by ops-bot: `rollout --pool=verm-standby-a --to-version=v5.0.0 --prewarm=true` at 08:22 UTC
paul: added temporary KV cache cap: `telemetry set kv_cache_limit=1GB --tenant=vermillion` to mitigate cache thrash.
raj: mitigation looks effective: error rate down to 0.6% at 08:30 UTC (baseline 0.2%). Still monitoring tail.
jen: starting customer comms: asking for exact impacted window and attempted retries. Vermillion reports about 9% errors between 08:12-08:20 UTC, mostly short-lived. No data loss reported.
yuri: exporting traces and heap dumps to incident bucket s3://redwood-incidents/4959876543/trace.tar.gz
sophie: running a targeted smoke: `prewarm-smoke --pool=verm-standby-a --threshold=95` -> passed.
raj: switching traffic back to standby fully at 08:35 UTC. Post-failover metrics stable.
jen: finance ask: estimate credits. My suggestion: prorated 7% credit for impacted window + one-month waived burst charges. Need AM input.
paul: engineering mitigations: (1) add `verify-quant-config` to artifact CI; (2) block quantized rollout without passing long-context prewarm; (3) add alert for rapid KV growth.
yuri: owners: yuri -> artifact validation + CI check, paul -> telemetry guardrail, raj -> runbook update and postmortem writeup.
incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2 at 08:40 UTC by ops
sophie: drafting RCA in docs: https://docs.redwood/incidents/4959876543-rca-draft (internal) — will post when ready.
jen: customer email draft: "We experienced elevated error rates due to a model artifact variant causing memory spikes during initialization. We isolated your traffic, failed over to standby, rolled back the artifact, and implemented temporary guardrails. We propose a prorated credit and a follow-up technical review."
raj: timeline: RCA draft within 48 hours; permanent fix (CI + prewarm) within 10 business days; runbook PR in 3 days.
paul: adding a follow-up: schedule a 1:1 tech review with Vermillion SREs. Jen, can you coordinate?
jen: yes — proposing Tuesday 14:00 UTC. I'll include AM + finance in invite.
yuri: will add telemetry alert: `alert: kv_cache_growth_rate > 200MB/min` -> page oncall.
sophie: handoff: raj handing bridge to jen at 09:05 UTC; jen will own post-incident comms and coordination.
raj: closing bridge, monitoring for 1 hour. nice job team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Bridge closed by jen at 09:05 UTC
jen: SENT initial customer email at 09:07 UTC. pasted copy into #customer-success/verm-drafts.
paul: RCA artifacts stored at s3://redwood-incidents/4959876543/ ; logs, heapdumps, and kernel traces available.
sophie: ran retro with SRE and runtime; draft runbook PR: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pull/1345 — please review.
jen: will draft exec summary for Lex and ops leadership. Include customer credit proposal and impact window.
raj: marking incident resolved in PagerDuty at 10:10 UTC. Close thread after RCA finalized.
